hypothesis: Observed risk changes across regimes; a fixed risk budget may retain more return than reacting only after account drawdown has accumulated
estimator: Population standard deviation of prior completed-session realised account return divided by that session's volatility multiplier; a risk proxy, not a counterfactual trading return
decision_clock: Calculate once at the first observed bar of each session, using only cached prior-session equity; hold multiplier constant for that session
evaluation: Actual broker replay, unchanged costs/capacity/flattening, same reused development data; both 8%/10% drawdown targets remain mandatory
